## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership concentrated across cyclicals (Materials, Energy, Industrials) with Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5); Value/Cyclical style favored.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +25.87%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +11.59%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: SLB (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +1.90%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +3.34%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials robust: CAT (1W: +7.69% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND, EMR (1W: +7.69% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.80% | 1M: +13.86%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: PEP (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.49%) BELOW TREND, MO (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: NFLX (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -12.18%) BELOW TREND. Technology internally mixed with notable weakness: AAPL (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -11.30%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: SLB (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +6.65%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +11.59%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated in Materials/Energy/Tech.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PEP (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.49%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -12.18%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -11.30%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.00% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-margin staples and select tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: SLB (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +9.16% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +6.65%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present — INTC (RECOVERY), GOOGL (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -0.97%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -0.06%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +2.10%) CORRECTION warrant watching for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed with internal dispersion; large-cap leaders under pressure while select semis surge — AAPL (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +6.65%) ABOVE TREND — sector rotation rather than broad breakout.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive and contributing to RISK-ON: JPM (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND — breadth supportive and consistent with Value/Cyclical leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare steady but mixed: UNH (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +5.35%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.33% | 1M: +1.14%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +4.88%) CORRECTION — sector showing defensive depth but not leading risk-on rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and select commodity-exposed names given Materials/Energy/Industrials strength (examples: NEM, SLB, CAT); reduce exposure to pressured mega-cap techs showing BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NOW). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth for tactical exposure; monitor the INTC/GOOGL/META/NVDA divergence before enlarging positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +5.35%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -4.75%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -11.30%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (7/7 positive), Energy (7/8 positive), Industrials (11/13 positive) — strong momentum. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (3/11 positive) and Communication (2/7 positive) — defensive lagging could underperform risk-on moves.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
SLB continuation above near-term highs supports Energy leadership; AMAT sustain above current 1W gains would confirm Tech semi strength; AAPL failure to reclaim recent support would keep large-cap Tech in BELOW TREND and reinforce rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
SLB (+50): Evercore upgrade; SLB (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. BA (+50): large aerospace wins; BA (1W: +5.80% | 1M: +13.86%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MO (+80): FDA pouch approval headline; MO (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price diverging (distribution).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-50): HSBC caution on deliveries; TSLA (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -4.75%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. AIG (-45): CEO change headlines; AIG (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +1.55%) CORRECTION — bearish sentiment aligning with short-term sell-off. INTU (-45): analyst scrutiny; INTU (1W: -4.00% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style favored as Materials, Energy and Industrials lead amid broad 9/11 sector participation. SLB (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +20.37%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +12.53% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-cap Techs and select majors (INTC RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY, NVDA CORRECTION) plus mixed news confirmations (MO bullish but BELOW TREND) — watch for trend breaks.
